map.根据火灾态势、建筑条件与到场力量，推荐进攻/防御战术方案与部署要点: Recommend offensive/defensive tactics and deployment key points from the fire situation, building conditions and on-scene forces.
map.：内攻灭火、堵截包围、上下夹击、分割穿插: : interior attack, cutoff and encirclement, attack from above and below, division and penetration
map.：冷却保护、隔离堵截、破拆排烟、设防保护: : cooling and protection, isolation and cutoff, breaching and ventilation, defensive protection
map.原则：先控制后消灭、先救人后灭火、先重点后一般: Principles: control before extinguishing, rescue before firefighting, priority first then the general
map.进攻转防御：火势失控、结构濒临坍塌、力量不足、水源中断: Offense to defense: fire out of control, structure near collapse, insufficient forces, water supply interrupted
map.防御转进攻：火势减弱、增援到场、水源恢复、结构趋于稳定: Defense to offense: fire diminishing, reinforcements on scene, water supply restored, structure tending to stabilize
map.灭火战术须由现场指挥员根据实时态势决定，本工具提供决策参考，不可替代现场判断。: Firefighting tactics must be decided by the on-scene commander according to the real-time situation; this tool provides decision support and cannot replace on-scene judgment.
map.到场后按火场发展阶段、面积与结构快速形成进攻/防御/撤退的战术决策。: On arrival, quickly form an offense/defense/withdrawal decision by the fire's development stage, area and structure.
map.力量部署演练中分配主攻、掩护、搜救、供水、安全各组职责与兵力。: In force-deployment drills, assign the duties and strength of the attack, cover, search-and-rescue, water-supply and safety teams.
map.培训中演示撤退信号的设定（结构异响/裂缝/钢构件变形/火势突变）。: In training, demonstrate how withdrawal signals are set (structural noises/cracks/steel-member deformation/sudden fire change).
map.200 m² 砖混结构发展阶段的进攻方案: Offensive plan for a 200 m² brick-concrete structure at the growth stage
map.按默认参数（发展阶段、着火面积 200 m²、砖混/框架结构、无被困人员）：推荐: With the default parameters (growth stage, fire area 200 m², brick-concrete/frame structure, no trapped occupants): the 'offense' mode is recommended; the attack team penetrates the fire area with two 19 mm nozzles directly at the seat of the fire (about 6.5 L/s each), the cover team flows water on the flanks to prevent the fire from outflanking, the search team searches the floors above and below simultaneously, and the water-supply team ensures an uninterrupted supply. Command key points: complete reconnaissance and decision-making within 5 minutes of arrival, reassess the situation every 15 minutes and keep 1/3 of the force as a reserve.
map.什么时候转防御或撤退？: When to switch to defense or withdraw?
map.当出现结构异常声响、裂缝扩大、钢构件明显变形或火势突变等征兆时，应立即发出全员撤: When signs such as abnormal structural noises, widening cracks, obvious deformation of steel members or a sudden change in the fire appear, order a full withdrawal immediately; when the fire area exceeds control capability or the water supply cannot be sustained, switch from offense to cutoff defense, control the spread and wait for reinforcements.
map.每支水枪为什么按 6.5 L/s 估算？: Why is each nozzle estimated at 6.5 L/s?
map.19 mm 水枪在充实水柱约 13~15 m 时流量约 6.5 L/s，是火场供: A 19 mm nozzle delivers about 6.5 L/s at a fire-stream reach of about 13-15 m, a common benchmark for water supply and force deployment, used to back-calculate the supply capacity required from fire engines, pump adapters and hose mains.
map.综合火灾阶段、建筑结构、着火面积、被困人员和到场力量，推荐进攻/防御/攻防结合战: Combining fire stage, building structure, fire area, trapped occupants and on-scene forces, recommend an offensive/defensive/combined mode and deployment plan.
